description: This file defines interrupt handling helpers, IRQ level determination, and includes for specific SoC variants for the RISC-V OpenISA RV32M1 platform within the Zephyr RTOS project.

methods.name: rv32m1_irq_level
methods.description: Determines whether an IRQ is level 1 or level 2 based on its number.

methods.name: rv32m1_level1_irq
methods.description: Returns the level 1 IRQ number associated with a given IRQ.

methods.name: rv32m1_intmux_channel
methods.description: Calculates the INTMUX channel (level 2 aggregator) for a given IRQ.

methods.name: rv32m1_intmux_line
methods.description: Returns the INTMUX interrupt ID for a given IRQ.

methods.name: INST_DT_CLOCK_IP_NAME
methods.description: Macro to convert device tree instance to HAL clock IP name.
